issue_context.title: Fix the `constructor` linter
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

The `constructor` linter is not valid after migrating the packages from `/util/linter/constructor` to `/pkg/util/linter/constructor`. We need to fix it.

review_comments: Let me clarify. In this PR you added `ignoreFields` to `getConstructorList` to skip some fields when recursively process `struct`. And I think this line is the cause of recursively processing `struct`. We don't need this line because `WithStack` still access the member of `struct`. Can we delete this line and delete the `ignoreFields` logic of `getConstructorList`?
should we don't recursively check the fields in line 90 instead of adding `ignoreFields` argument? Not sure `(*inspector.Inspector).WithStack` still can do a recursively check.
@yibin87 PTAL. It can guarantee that `BaseExecutorV2` will not be manually initialized except in `NewBaseExecutorV2` and `BuildNewBaseExecutorV2`.
